The [[Glymphid/Legends|Glymphid]] [[Podracer/Legends|Podracer]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Aldar Beedo/Legends|Aldar Beedo]] used a '''modified Manta RamAir Podracer''' during the [[Vinta Harvest Classic/Legends|Vinta Harvest Classic]] of [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. While Beedo utilized the same [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]] from his [[Mk IV Flat Twin Turbojet/Legends|''MARK IV'' Flat-Twin Turbojet]], the [[Engine/Legends|engines]] were only half the size of the normal ''MARK IV'' engines. Whereas the normal model made use of two jets, each engine on this racer had only one, thus making the engines much thinner, allowing the podracer to perform narrow courses well. The engines were also marked with the same designs, albeit more cropped due to the reduced size, that his larger RamAir racer had.
